title: Resolved repository criteria
description: Criteria of one repository after the CLI has read its overlay, its legacy files or its defaults from the target branch.

ref.description: Target branch the criteria were read from.

dimensions.description: Dimension values the repository sets, by dimension id; detection decides the others.

additionalProperties.description: Value of the dimension named by the key.

disabledRules.description: Repository rules that are not applied.

ruleOptions.description: Option values of rules that were applied, by rule id; the ignored ones are in notes.

rules.description: Rules the repository defines in its criteria files, in file order, without the ignored ones.

noise.description: Globs of changed files listed as noise, from the packs and the repository.

publicApi.description: Globs of files that are public API, whose removals are checked against the consumers.

consumers.description: Repositories that use this one's public API.

cascade.description: Cascade limits the repository sets; an absent field takes its default. They are used only when the review starts from this repository.

maxDepth.description: Deepest level of Related Changes that is reviewed; the root is level 0. The default is 3.

maxChangeRequests.description: Most change requests reviewed in one cascade, the root included, counted in discovery order. The default is 10.

files.description: Criteria files that were read, relative to the repository root.

notes.description: Notes for the summary, for example that legacy criteria are in use.

criteriaSource.description: Where the criteria come from: overlay is .agent-code-review/, legacy is .github/skills and .github/mr-review.json, default is the packs alone.

dimensionId.description: Identifier of a dimension or of one of its values: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

glob.description: Path glob with forward slashes: '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any number of segments.

optionValues.description: Values for the options of one rule, by parameter name.

additionalProperties.description: Value of the parameter named by the key; it must lie within the bounds the rule declares.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

repositoryRule.description: A rule of the repository: a list item of the form - `<id>` — **<SEVERITY>**. <text> in a criteria file.

id.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

source.description: Always repository: the rule comes from the repository, not from a pack.

severity.description: Severity of the rule; repository rules have no INFO.

text.description: What the rule says, after its severity, in Markdown.

file.description: Criteria file the rule is written in.

line.description: 1-based line of the rule's list item.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.
